svg.title: C19-M08-F2: Two audiences, two reports
svg.desc: The contents of the executive and technical reports.
svg.text: EXECUTIVE : scope + authorisation ; coverage (4/7=57%) ; risk ; top 3 recommendations
TECHNICAL : per-technique (ATT&CK, safety, DETECTED/GAP) ; containment ; retest list
both : every statement traced to evidence ; honest about coverage/limits
